UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='buy-on-etsy-button', data-testid='language-switcher-it').
Header and dropdowns MUST NOT have fully transparent background. Always use glassmorphism with dark blurred background bg-[#0B1320]/85 backdrop-blur-md.
Use react-router-dom for multi-page navigation seamlessly.
Ensure all components use .js or .jsx file extension as per React JavaScript structure.
Maintain strict APCA/WCAG contrast: text on dark background must maintain strong legibility.
Support both Italian and English via state/context with instant language switching across all pages.
